arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills are empowered. Damaging an enemy with a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill causes them to take {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from your other {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Reap{/c} attacks {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1" * 100|%|]{/c} faster.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Decompose{/c} now spawns a Corpse every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|1|]{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} triggers an additional burst on the initial target.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Bone Splinters{/c} pierce through enemies.
